map.📏 牙周袋深度与附着丧失评估器: Periodontal Pocket Depth and Attachment-Loss Assessor
map.根据探诊深度(PD)与龈缘至釉牙骨质界(CEJ)距离，计算临床附着丧失(CAL): Calculates clinical attachment loss (CAL) from probing depth (PD) and the distance from the gingival margin to the cementoenamel junction (CEJ) to assess periodontitis severity.

map.输入说明：龈缘位于 CEJ 冠方（牙龈增生/假性牙周袋）输入: Input note: gingival margin coronal to CEJ (gingival hyperplasia / false pocket) enter
map.；龈缘位于 CEJ 根方（牙龈退缩）输入: ; gingival margin apical to CEJ (gingival recession) enter
map.⚠️ 本工具供临床参考。附着丧失是反映牙周组织破坏程度的关键指标，CAL 值越高: This tool is for clinical reference. Attachment loss is the key indicator of periodontal destruction; the higher the CAL, the more supporting tissue lost. Diagnosis needs full-mouth exam and imaging.
map.CAL = PD + (龈缘至CEJ距离): CAL = PD + (gingival margin to CEJ distance)
map.龈缘在CEJ根方为正(退缩) → CAL增大: Gingival margin apical to CEJ is positive (recession) -> CAL increases
map.龈缘在CEJ冠方为负(增生) → CAL减小: Gingival margin coronal to CEJ is negative (hyperplasia) -> CAL decreases
map.📚 深度解析：牙周袋深度与附着丧失评估器: In-Depth: Periodontal Pocket Depth and Attachment-Loss Assessor
map.牙周初诊多牙位探诊，工具由 PD 与 CEJ 距离算 CAL 并分级牙周炎。: At periodontal first visit, probe multiple sites; the tool computes CAL from PD and CEJ distance and grades periodontitis.
map.疗效随访对比 CAL 变化，判断支持组织是否稳定。: Follow-up compares CAL change to judge whether supporting tissue is stable.
map.种植周探诊同样方法评估边缘骨丧失。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初筛参考，不替代口: Peri-implant probing uses the same method to assess marginal bone loss. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：探诊深度 PD=7mm，龈缘至 CEJ 距离 = 2mm（龈退缩）\n计算:
Input: probing depth PD=7mm, gingival margin to CEJ distance = 2mm (gingival recession)
Calculation: clinical attachment loss CAL = PD + recession = 7 + 2 = 9mm
Note: CAL reflects true support loss, more stable than PD; severe periodontitis CAL>=6mm.
map.PD 和 CAL 区别？: What is the difference between PD and CAL?
map.PD 是龈沟底到龈缘的软组织深度，受牙龈肿胀/退缩影响；CAL 再加 CEJ 距: PD is the soft-tissue depth from the sulcus bottom to the gingival margin, affected by swelling/recession; CAL adds the CEJ distance, reflecting true attachment-support loss, more reliable.
map.常按 CAL 与骨丧失：轻度 CAL 1~2mm、中度 3~4mm、重度 ≥6m: Usually by CAL and bone loss: mild CAL 1-2mm, moderate 3-4mm, severe >=6mm, combined with bleeding on probing and tooth position.
map.出血、口臭是牙周炎吗？: Are bleeding and bad breath periodontitis?
map.牙龈出血、红肿、口臭、牙齿松动是牙周炎常见表现；确诊与分期需牙周探诊与 X 线，: Gum bleeding, redness, bad breath and loose teeth are common signs of periodontitis; diagnosis and staging need periodontal probing and X-ray; visit a periodontal specialist.
